security_help.title: Security guide
security_help.description: How to use two-factor authentication, active sessions, and security keys, and what to do when you notice a suspicious login.

twofa.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
twofa.intro: Adds a second step of identity verification on top of your password to protect your account. Even if your password leaks, a third party cannot log in with it alone.

setup_steps.step1: Prepare an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator) on your smartphone.
setup_steps.step2: Press "Set up 2FA" to display a QR code and a secret key.
setup_steps.step3: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (if you cannot scan it, enter the secret key manually).
setup_steps.step4: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the authenticator app to finish enabling.

twofa.backup_desc: Backup codes are a spare way in when you can no longer use your authenticator app, for example because you lost your smartphone. Store them in a safe place. Each code can be used only once. Pressing "Regenerate backup codes" issues new codes and invalidates all old ones.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.intro: A list of devices currently logged in to your account. You can check here whether there are any devices you don't recognize.
sessions.row_desc: Each row is one device, showing browser/OS information, IP address, and login time. The string of Latin characters at the start is the browser and OS information used.
sessions.current_tag_desc: The row with the "Current" tag is the device you are using right now.
sessions.revoke_desc: You can invalidate (log out) a suspicious row individually with the "×" button.
sessions.revoke_all_desc: Press "Log out all" to sign out all other devices at once.
sessions.current_note: The session you are using right now cannot be removed individually, so that you do not lock yourself out by mistake (the server rejects that action). To sign out everywhere, use "Log out all".

webauthn.title: Security keys (WebAuthn)
webauthn.intro: A way to log in using fingerprint or face recognition, or a physical security key (FIDO2). You can log in quickly and securely without entering a password.
webauthn.manage_desc: You can give registered keys easy-to-recognize names (rename). Keys you no longer use can be deleted.

suspicious.title: If you find a login you don't recognize
suspicious.intro: If you notice anything suspicious, such as an unknown device in your active sessions, work through these steps from the top.

steps.step1: Invalidate sessions you don't recognize with "×"
steps.step2: If in doubt, sign out of every device with "Log out all"
steps.step5: Store your backup codes in a safe place

contact_request_blocks_help.title: How to Use the Contact Request Block List
contact_request_blocks_help.description: This setting lets you automatically ignore contact-add requests from specific people before they reach you.

what.title: What is the Contact Request Block List?
what.body: If someone on this list tries to add you as a contact, their request is automatically ignored. You won't receive any notification and won't even know they tried.
what.note: The other person is never told they were blocked. You can quietly stop requests from specific people without any awkwardness.

list.title: Reading the List
list.body: All blocked users are shown in a list. Each row contains the following information.
list.item_name: Icon and name — who you are blocking
list.item_handle: Contact handle starting with {'@'} — the person's unique ID
list.item_date: "Set on" — the date the block was registered

unblock.title: How to Remove a Block
unblock.body: You can remove a block at any time. Once removed, that person can send you a contact-add request again.

steps.step1: Find the row of the person you want to unblock.
steps.step2: Press the "Unblock" button on the right side of the row.
steps.step3: When the person disappears from the list, the block has been successfully removed.

qa.title: Frequently Asked Questions (Q&A)
qa.description: Answers to common questions about using Mannschaft, installing the PWA, and more.

tutorial_banner.title: New to Mannschaft?
tutorial_banner.description: Take the tutorial to learn the basics

pwa_cta.title: It's even better as an app!
pwa_cta.description: Add to your home screen to use it offline and receive push notifications.

q1.question: Are there any feature differences between PC and smartphone?
q1.answer: Core features work identically on every device. Smartphones are optimized for touch input and can be installed as a PWA on the home screen. PCs let you view more information at once on a large screen and type quickly using keyboard shortcuts.

q2.question: What's the recommended way to use it on a smartphone?
q2.answer: Install the PWA and launch it from the home screen. The browser address bar disappears, giving you a native-app feel. Use long-press menus for quick actions, swipe to switch screens, and tap notifications to jump directly to related pages.

q3.question: How do I change my profile picture?
q3.answer: Tap the icon in the top-right corner, go to Settings -> Profile, and upload a new image using the change button.

q4.question: How do I change the display language?
q4.answer: Go to Settings -> Language to switch between Japanese, English, Chinese, Korean, Spanish, and German.

q5.question: Where can I log out?
q5.answer: Tap the Log out button in the navigation bar, or on mobile, find Log out inside the menu.

q1.question: What is a PWA?
q1.answer: A PWA (Progressive Web App) lets you use a website like an app. Once added to your home screen, it launches like a regular app and works offline. No installation via Google Play or App Store is required.

q2.question: What are the benefits of installing the PWA?
q2.answer:
- Launch with one tap from the home screen
- Browse and draft content even offline
- Receive push notifications
- Full-screen experience without the browser address bar
- Fast startup
- Lower data usage

q3.question: How do I install it on an Android phone?
q3.answer: Open this page in Chrome and tap the Install button at the top of this Q&A page. When the 'Add to Home screen' dialog appears, tap Add.

q4.question: How do I install it on an iPhone?
q4.answer: Open the page in Safari, tap the Share button at the bottom (square with an up arrow), choose 'Add to Home Screen', then tap Add. Note that Chrome and Firefox on iOS cannot install PWAs.

q1.question: Can I use the app offline?
q1.answer: Yes. Once you install the PWA, most screens are available offline. Input actions such as action memos, quick memos, and adding TODOs are saved on the device and sent automatically when you reconnect.

q2.question: What happens to data I edited while offline?
q2.answer: It syncs automatically when you come back online. If another device or member edited the same data first, you can resolve it manually from the Conflict Resolution screen.

q1.question: I'm not receiving notifications. Why?
q1.answer: You must install the PWA and allow notifications when prompted on first launch. Check that notifications are not blocked in your browser or OS settings. iOS supports PWA notifications from iOS 16.4 and later.

q2.question: Pages won't load or the app behaves strangely.
q2.answer: First, clear your browser cache. If the issue persists, try uninstalling and reinstalling the PWA. If it still doesn't work, please contact support.

calendar_sync_help.title: How to use Google Calendar Integration
calendar_sync_help.description: Automatically sync your schedules with Google Calendar so you can check them from your phone or other apps.

what.title: What is Google Calendar Integration?
what.body: Mannschaft schedules (personal, team, and organization) are automatically reflected in Google Calendar. Once connected, you can always check your schedules from any device or app that supports Google Calendar.

connect.title: Connecting your account
connect.body: Click "Connect Google Account" to go to Google's sign-in screen. Granting calendar access completes the connection. You can disconnect at any time using the "Disconnect" button.

toggles.title: Turning sync on/off individually
toggles.body: You can toggle sync on or off separately for "Personal Calendar", "Team Calendars", and "Organization Calendars". Changes apply immediately — there is no save button.
toggles.item_personal: Personal Calendar: syncs your own personal schedules
toggles.item_team: Team Calendars: syncs schedules of teams you belong to
toggles.item_org: Organization Calendars: syncs schedules of organizations you belong to

sync_behavior.title: When sync happens
sync_behavior.body: Turning sync on backfills all previously unsynced schedules at once. This may take a few minutes if there are many. Use the "Manual Sync" button whenever you want to reflect the latest state immediately.
